name: text-equal-to-the-exact-sentinel-is-absent
reference: spec/engine-spec.md 0.56 `absent` by range: on xml one leading `=` is stripped (0.9 ruling 12) and "=>=5 is the exact text >=5", so the sentinel is exact, not a range. The attribute text after references is >=5, equal to the sentinel: absent. Encode writes the sentinel >=5 as the attribute value, `>` escaped as > (1a and 1f of 0.11). Derived by hand.
